title: Verify invalid tank-volume curves across file loading and API updates
research_next_step: Finish parser/validation and build audit, create an isolated pinned native build, and run synthetic networks through the real library. Compare file loading, EN_VOLCURVE/EN_settankdata assignment and subsequent curve edits using increasing, decreasing and interior-dip volume curves; include valid decreasing pump, cylindrical tank and unit controls. Measure errors and finite volume/area behavior before choosing a fix.
problem: Issue #883 reports acceptance of decreasing tank-volume curves. Current assignment/initialization paths compute volumes and endpoint-derived area without local Y-monotonicity checks; complete parser acceptance and runtime failure mode are unverified.
humanitarian_relevance: Clear validation may improve reliability of water-network analysis tools. No measured effect on drinking-water safety, utility decisions or resource use.

evidence.claim: Reporter says invalid tank-volume curves can produce decreasing volume while filling and a floating-point exception when negative area is converted to diameter. These runtime claims have not been independently reproduced.

Pinned file initialization and two API assignment routes derive area from endpoint slope. Curve point/bulk setters check increasing X but not Y; generic decreasing pump curves must remain valid. Existing curve/node tests inspected, not run.

code_surface: At dev 83e25bbe2b0b460803e71df03bc989afe9557ea3: src/input1.c inittanks; src/epanet.c EN_setnodevalue EN_VOLCURVE, EN_settankdata, EN_setcurve, EN_setcurvevalue and EN_setcurvetype. tests/test_curve.cpp and tests/test_node.cpp. Complete parser validation still to trace.
proposed_change: First reproduce invalid-data handling through the real library and agree scope. Consider consistent tank-specific validation across relevant entry points only after maintainer confirmation; preserve generic/pump curve semantics and document errors/rollback.
tests: Existing curve/node tests located. Plan full native baseline where feasible and synthetic file/API cases with monotonic, decreasing, interior-dip, cylindrical, pump and unit controls. No target execution yet.
environment: Native CMake C/C++ build; optional Boost-based CTest suite. Root/run/output/test CMake files and macOS/Linux CI inspected. BUILD_TESTS defaults off in inspected CI commands. Generated output header is copied into source tree. Clang present; CMake/Boost not located in checked paths. No clone/install/build or operational data.
maintainer: Issue reported by LRossman; no assignment or Humanifest scope confirmation. General README invites discussion before fork-based changes. No outreach yet.
risks: Negative square root need not crash; measure actual errors/nonfinite values. Positive endpoint slope can hide interior dips. Generic decreasing curves may be valid for pumps. Changes after assignment and metric/US units may require broader consistency than a single check.
